category.reason: The current rotation angle is indicated by a narrow tick among similar neighboring ruler marks, requiring precise localization without a numeric readout.

instruction.en: Locate the tick mark that indicates the current rotation angle on the rotation adjustment ruler.
instruction.zh: 定位旋转角度调节标尺上表示当前角度的刻度线。

reference.patch: Created a Midscene-authored testcase from a contributor-provided 1260 × 2844 JPEG screenshot of a photo rotation editor. Used the built-in imagegen tool to composite out the “-8.0” numeric readout below the rotation-angle ruler, removing the text-based positioning clue while retaining the ruler and its current-angle tick. The generated screenshot is an 835 × 1884 PNG. Authored new English and Chinese instructions to locate the current rotation-angle tick, classified the task as Small Target, and annotated groundTruth as [1472, 421, 1524, 415] in [top, right, bottom, left] pixels on the generated image.
